ClickUpOAuthCredential.description:
OAuth 2.0 credential for ClickUp (authorization_code flow).

Tokens are obtained via the OAuth flow, not entered manually. ClickUp has no
scope system; access is granted per-Workspace during consent. ClickUp access
tokens do not currently expire and no refresh token is issued, so
refresh_token/expires_at are usually empty.

Register an OAuth app at: https://app.clickup.com/settings/apps

ClickUpTaskTriggerConfig.description:
Fire the workflow on selected ClickUp webhook event(s).

The user picks WHICH event(s) fire via ``event_types`` (task/list/folder/
space/goal lifecycle events, or ``*`` for all). The selection is passed to
ClickUp's ``POST /team/{team_id}/webhook`` ``events`` array and re-checked at
runtime against the inbound payload's ``event`` field.

team_id.description: The Workspace (team) to subscribe to events from
team_id.title: Workspace

event_types.description:
Which ClickUp event fires this workflow. 'All events' (*) subscribes to every event below.
- Task created / updated / deleted: a task is added, edited, or removed.
- Task priority / status / assignee / due date / tag updated: a specific task field changes.
- Task moved: a task changes list/folder/space.
- Task comment posted / updated: a comment is added or edited on a task.
- Task time estimate / time tracked updated: estimate or logged time changes.
- List / Folder / Space created / updated / deleted: hierarchy containers change.
- Goal / Key result created / updated / deleted: goals and their key results change.
event_types.title: Trigger On

webhook_url.description: ClickUp posts task events here. Registered automatically when you connect credentials.
webhook_url.title: Webhook URL

ClickUpTaskTriggerConfig.title: ClickUpTaskTriggerConfig
